column1: Purpose: Log every non-ad cost it takes to generate a call: labor, contractors, software, lead data, and anything else, so the Dashboard reflects your true acquisition spend.
1. Enter your costs for each category every month, Total adds them up on its own.
2. Software & Tools covers outreach software, landing page software, tracking software, and email infrastructure.
3. Don't leave out real costs because they make the numbers look worse, the point is to see reality.
4. Add more columns here if you track another recurring cost category, just make sure Total includes them.
5. This feeds the Dashboard's Cost Per Call numbers, so keep it updated every month.
